name: eternities-agora
intent: Reconcile authorized prospect, account, and client-deliverable evidence into one bounded, traceable artifact without expanding authority.
successCondition: One dominant route produces a scope-bound artifact whose evidence, confidence, assumptions, gaps, effects, handoffs, and termination are explicit.
inputs: authorized prospect, account, portfolio, or client evidence
requested route scope or mode and desired artifact
evidence, identity, scoring, service, pricing, rendering, and authority policies when applicable
outputs: prospect assessment, account state contract, proposal draft, or verified report artifact
evidence lineage, confidence, gaps, assumptions, and performed effects
bounded refusal, decision request, or specialist handoff
operations: separate observed derived assumed and proposed claims
apply disclosed scoring or commercial policy
produce one bounded artifact and verify its acceptance contract
positiveTriggers: assess a prospect at rapid or multidimensional evidence depth
reconstruct portfolio pipeline client account or agency operational state
turn verified client findings into a service proposal or validated report
negativeTriggers: routine record lookup status edit or copy change
legal drafting enforceability judgment financial planning or regulated advice
KYC regulated identity screening or runtime administration
external communication publication commitment purchase or account mutation without separate authority
failureModes: evidence is missing stale conflicting or malformed
scoring service pricing or rendering policy is unresolved
the requested effect exceeds local read or local write authority
the mission crosses a regulated or specialist boundary
terminationConditions: one dominant route has produced one scope-bound artifact
sources assumptions gaps conflicts score policy and performed effects are visible
unsupported actions are refused or represented by one bounded handoff
no external regulated background or recursive operation remains implied
